name: Shahal Ahammed K
tagline: I turn messy data and consumer signals into decisions businesses can act on.
about: I'm a data and research professional working at the point where numbers meet the market. I'm currently a Business Commercial Specialist at vivo Middle East, where I connect commercial performance with what consumers actually do.

My background is in data science and analytics. I've worked across Python, SQL, R, Power BI and Tableau, and I use both quantitative and qualitative research methods, so I can explain what is happening and also why it is happening.
status: Open to Data, Research & Business Analyst roles

services.text: Dashboards and reporting in Power BI and Tableau, so teams can follow the metrics that matter.

services.title: Consumer & Market Research
services.text: Qualitative and quantitative studies that explain why customers choose, switch or stay.
